micro.boundary: Same indexed workload. baseline uses the saved original build; other WASM variants use the current build. number-* drops range checks and is diagnostic only. No UE. No CPU profiler. validateCalls adds per-call instrumentation and its timings must not be used for performance claims.

apiEquivalence.description: Per-pass method-order/argument hash and method count agree with the original build. Instrumented timings excluded.

browser.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/156.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/156.0.0.0

villa.boundary: Same pthread WASM and Cook for every run; only startup threading/core-limit or WebGPUImmediateCalls flags vary. Bridge tests retain full threading and the default core count. Visible Edge, 2289x1287 CSS, DPR 1, fixed default spawn, normal browser cache. Timings use completed RHI viewport presents, no per-draw instrumentation or CPU sampling.

profile.boundary: Statistical wall-clock stack sampling. Inclusive values overlap; idle, futex and CPU compute are distinct. FPS from these captures is not the normal benchmark.
